# `pageHead`

Helper: `pageHead(title, sub, actions, eyebrow)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `PageHeading` (`workspace.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaHeading` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Title (page 30/700), sub line (body, ink-soft), actions on the right; optional eyebrow.

## Variants

- With or without actions
- With an eyebrow

## States

- Actions follow the button states

## Tokens

heading, ink-soft, text-page, text-body

## Do

- One per page, first block
- Primary action last, secondary before it

## Don't

- Do not repeat the menu name as the only text
- Do not put filters here (filters are chips or fields under it)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Title 30; actions sit on the right and wrap under the title when the line is full.

## Mobile (390)

Title drops to 25 (title); actions wrap below the text and become full-height 44px buttons.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

One per page, first block. Actions are inline blocks (buttons)
